This update is notable for adding the [[Violent Night Event]] to the game. This version encompasses twelve updates, the main v1.6.0 update (released 21 December 2022) and eleven minor updates, the v1.6.0a (released 21 December 2022), v1.6.0b (released 24 December 2022),
